name: Shodan (InternetDB, CVEDB, REST API, web host pages)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 BR2; 'Shodan is an established company: tier trusted', P039 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Internet-wide scanner observations (may be days old); CVEs are version-inferred from banners/CPEs and must be confirmed on the host.

shodan.plan_hint: business = a company-held subscription whose licence covers internal commercial use (P039 cond 2); membership, academic and free keys count as noncommercial

internetdb.title: Shodan InternetDB (keyless open ports, hostnames, CPEs, tags and CVEs per IP)

terms.quote: Shodan InternetDB, Shodan CVEDB, VirusTotal public API and Censys free = 'noncommercial'.

internetdb.notes: Quote: binding A1 initial class (the docs page carries no terms text). Off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared; never replaced by an active port scan (A1).
internetdb.licensed_alternative: A commercial Shodan subscription covering InternetDB (source shodan.api with key_plans.shodan='business'), or a licence_allow entry recording a written Shodan permission.

cvedb.title: Shodan CVEDB (keyless CVE details, EPSS, KEV flag, product search)

terms.quote: free for non-commercial use! If you're using the CVEDB API to make money, then you need an enterprise license

cvedb.notes: A1 initial class 'noncommercial' (P189 cond 2). Off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared.
cvedb.licensed_alternative: A Shodan enterprise licence (recorded licence_allow entry); CIRCL vulnerability-lookup + FIRST EPSS + CISA KEV cover the gap.

api.title: Shodan REST API (keyed host, DNS and search endpoints; on-demand scan endpoints are never wired)

terms.quote: Key-terms: a company-held Shodan API subscription whose licence covers internal commercial use, recorded as key_plans.shodan='business' with the terms URL.

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P039 cond 2). Runs under the corporate profile only with key_plans.shodan == 'business'. The key travels as ?key= and is masked by the central redactor (AR01).

notes: Owned by core (WP02). www.shodan.io host pages sit behind a Cloudflare challenge for scripts: manual pivot links only (core_reference:shodan_host).
